admission.justification: The case proves a server with configured providers is refused; the old field is no longer sent, so the check passed silently and could not prevent that error.

applicability: Every admission that reads the selected build's server_info answer.
conditions: The selected build sends its configured-provider field in server_info.
exclusions: A server with no configured providers passes this check; the root and repository checks remain separate.
statement: The admission's provider check reads the field server_info actually sends for configured providers and refuses a server that has any.
